title: ObjectKinematicTree: an efficient ODE2 Jacobian
author: Claude-JG
description: ObjectKinematicTree declares ODE2_ODE2 and ODE2_ODE2_t without a function, so CSystem differentiates the whole tree numerically and serially, one evaluation of ComputeMassMatrixAndODE2LHS per coordinate. Decided: an analytic or automatic Jacobian of the forces of the joints (springs, dampers, the PD control, the gyroscopic terms), measured on the kinematic tree performance model first.
